description: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 Score (%) achieved by two methods—“MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”—as a function of the Number of tokens, which ranges from 0.6 to 1.4 and is displayed on a linear scale with tick labels at regular intervals. The y-axis, representing the Macro-F1 Score (%), spans from 48% to 58% and is also linearly scaled. The “MATTER (ours)” method is depicted by a reddish-brown line with circular markers, starting at approximately 55.2% at 0.6 tokens, peaking at 58% at 1.0 token, and ending at approximately 50.7% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” method is shown by a dark purple line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 52.3% at 0.6 tokens, remaining relatively flat around 52% until 1.2 tokens, then sharply declining to 48% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines exhibit shaded regions indicating variability or confidence intervals around their respective data points.
